data.narrative:
Agile Robots is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised approximately $384M to date and carries a last post-money valuation exceeding $1.0B. The valuation assessment relies on a peer universe of nine comparable companies—one public and eight private—spanning robotics and manufacturing at same or adjacent funding stages. Key private comparables include Hadrian, Nimble Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from the last $1.0B post-money valuation, implying $1.7B. The peer-median approach benchmarks against six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies with a median valuation of $1.7B and a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B, including Exotec at $2.0B, Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, Hadrian at $1.6B, and Dexterity at $1.6B. Both methods converge on $1.7B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median point estimate of $1.7B. The tight convergence between methods reduces estimation error, though key uncertainties remain around near-term growth trajectory, capital efficiency versus peer set, and execution risk in a capital-intensive sector. The $1.7B median reflects fair value within the observed peer distribution but should be stress-tested against company-specific unit economics and fundraising velocity.
